import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def transform(grid):
    H=len(grid); W=len(grid[0])
    # find horizontal separator row
    for i in range(H):
        if len(set(grid[i]))==1 and grid[i][0] not in (0,) and grid[i][0]!=grid[0][0] or (len(set(grid[i]))==1 and grid[i][0]!=0 and not all(grid[i][0]==x for x in [])):
            pass
    sep_rows=[i for i in range(H) if len(set(grid[i]))==1 and grid[i][0]!=0]
    sep_cols=[j for j in range(W) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(H)})==1 and grid[0][j]!=0]
    if sep_rows:
        si=sep_rows[0]
        top=grid[:si]; bot=grid[si+1:]
        return [[2 if a!=0 and b!=0 else 0 for a,b in zip(ra,rb)] for ra,rb in zip(top,bot)]
    else:
        sc=sep_cols[0]
        left=[r[:sc] for r in grid]; right=[r[sc+1:] for r in grid]
        return [[2 if a!=0 and b!=0 else 0 for a,b in zip(ra,rb)] for ra,rb in zip(left,right)]

print(transform(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'])
print(transform(G['Demo pair 2 input'])==G['Demo pair 2 output'])
res=transform(G['Test input'])
print(len(res),len(res[0]))
print(json.dumps(res))
